label: Printful
description: 1. In Printful, add a Manual order platform / API store and design your products in it. 2. Open Settings → Developers and create a private token for that store with the 'orders', 'sync_products' and 'webhooks' scopes. 3. Paste it below and save, then choose Actions → Sync products now. Your products arrive in Swell as drafts to review, and an hourly sync keeps them up to date. 4. Enable the carrier in Settings → Shipping → Printful, then click Save changes — rates do not dispatch until you do. 5. Leave Live fulfillment off until you have inspected a draft order in the Printful dashboard.

actions.label: Sync products now
actions.hint: Reads your Printful products now instead of waiting for the hourly sync.

fields.label: Printful API token
fields.description: Private token from Printful Settings → Developers, for your Manual order platform / API store. Needs the 'orders', 'sync_products' and 'webhooks' scopes. Use a separate token for your test environment.

fields.label: Printful store ID
fields.description: Only needed for account-level tokens that can see more than one Printful store. Leave empty for a store-level token.

fields.label: Live fulfillment
fields.description: When off, paid orders are submitted to Printful as drafts and never confirmed, so nothing is printed or charged. Turn this on only after a draft order looks correct in the Printful dashboard.

fields.label: Fallback shipping rate
fields.description: Flat rate offered when Printful is slow, rate-limited or unreachable. Leave empty to offer no Printful service at all when the quote fails.

fields.label: Fallback service name
fields.description: Name shown at checkout for the fallback rate.

fields.label: Quote cache lifetime
fields.description: How long a shipping quote is reused for the same destination and cart. Printful allows 120 requests per minute across the whole app, so caching is what keeps checkout inside that budget. Set 0 to disable.

fields.label: Rate request timeout
fields.description: How long to wait for a Printful quote before falling back. The whole function is killed at 10000ms, so keep this below 9000.

fields.label: Webhook secret key
fields.description: Written by the app when it registers the Printful webhook. Printful shows this value once and re-registering rotates it, so do not edit or clear it by hand.

fields.label: Webhook public key
fields.description: Written by the app alongside the secret key. Used to confirm inbound events came from this webhook registration.

fields.label: Last product sync
fields.description: When the app last read your Printful products. It runs every hour, and whenever you choose Sync now.

fields.label: Last sync result
fields.description: What the last sync did, and any errors — for example a token without the 'sync_products' scope.

fields.label: Sync now
fields.hint: Reads your Printful products now instead of waiting for the hourly sync.
